bio.text: Marty Jackley, a Republican from Pierre, is South Dakota's attorney general and the Republican candidate for the state's at-large U.S. House seat in 2026.
He has been attorney general since 2023, after serving in the same office from 2009 to 2019, and was U.S. attorney for South Dakota from 2006 to 2009.
Jackley announced his House run in 2025; the seat is open because Rep. Dusty Johnson is running for governor.

sources.title: Marty Jackley seeks South Dakota's sole US House seat
